leads.title: Constitution of Bolivia - Article 14(II)
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity

leads.title: Constitution of Bolivia - Article 63
leads.detail: Article 63 cited in Recognition of same-sex relationships section

leads.title: Law Against Racism and All Forms of Discrimination (Ley Contra el Racismo y Toda Forma de Discriminacion)
leads.documents: Defines discrimination including sexual orientation and gender identity, defines homophobia and transphobia, amends Penal Code article 281 to criminalize discrimination and bans dissemination/incitement with 1-5 years imprisonment
leads.detail: Amends Penal Code article 281; dissemination provision cited

leads.title: Penal Code - Article 40bis and Article 281ter
leads.documents: Hate-crime aggravation of penalties for crimes motivated by discriminatory grounds including sexual orientation and gender identity since 2010
leads.detail: Article 40bis aggravates penalties for motives in 281ter; May 2016 draft hate-crimes bill by Colectivo de Lesbianas, Gays, Bisexuales y personas Transgenero proposing 30 years cited

leads.title: Gender Identity Law (Ley de Identidad de Genero)
leads.documents: Allows persons over 18 to legally change name, sex and photo via Civil Registry Service in 15 days with psychological test, no surgery required, confidential, reversible once; took effect 1 August 2016; first use by activist Pamela Valenzuela
leads.detail: Passed Chamber of Deputies 19 May 2016, Senate 20 May 2016, signed 21 May 2016 by Vice President Alvaro Garcia Linera, effective 1 August 2016

leads.title: Supreme Electoral Tribunal instruction June 2017 / Supreme Court of Bolivia ruling November 2017
leads.documents: Electoral Tribunal instructed Civil Registry to recognize newly assigned sex for marriage; Supreme Court invalidated instruction as unconstitutional, ruling sex changed under Gender Identity Law may not be recognized for marriage; appeal to Inter-American Court filed May 2018
leads.detail: June 2017 instruction, November 2017 invalidation, May 2018 IACHR appeal

leads.title: Inter-American Court of Human Rights Advisory Opinion OC-24/17
leads.documents: Requires parties to American Convention to grant same-sex couples access to all family registration including marriage with all derived rights; binding precedent for Bolivian courts used for free union registrations
leads.detail: Advisory Opinion OC-24/17 of 24 November 2017, issued 9 January 2018

leads.title: Plurinational Constitutional Court ruling 22 June 2022 / Supreme Electoral Tribunal announcement 21 July 2023
leads.documents: Obliged Civil Registry Service (SERECI) to recognise same-sex civil unions/free unions and urged legislation; in effect 20 March 2023; regulations modified for same requirements/timings as heterosexual couples; 15 couples registered by Jan 2023 per MANODIVERSA
leads.detail: Ruled 22 June 2022, published/effective 20 March 2023; SERECI Resolution 003/2020 of 9 Dec 2020 and Second Constitutional Chamber of La Paz 3 July 2020 ruling for David Aruquipa Perez and Guido Montano Duran registered 18 Dec 2020 cited as precedent

leads.title: Bolivian Ombudsman (Defensoria del Pueblo) 2017 report
leads.documents: Documents lethal violence/enforcement gap: 64 LGBT people murdered in that year, only 14 investigated, none resulted in sentence

leads.title: Supreme Decree No. 24547 of 1997 as amended 10 July 2019
leads.documents: Permits men who have sex with men to donate blood; previously banned homosexual/bisexual men as high-risk group; Ombudsman requested amendment June 2016 under anti-discrimination law
leads.detail: Decreto Supremo No. 24547, reform effective 10 July 2019
